fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Lord Krishna Idol – Rajasthani Art Sculpture
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring home the blessings of divinity with this intricately hand-carved wooden idol of Lord Krishna, crafted by skilled artisans of Rajasthan. Krishna, the embodiment of love, joy, and compassion, is depicted in his signature pose, playing the flute with graceful charm. Made from natural wood, this sculpture reflects fine detailing and traditional craftsmanship, making it a timeless piece of art. Perfect for puja rooms, home décor, office desks, or gifting, this idol exudes peace and positivity wherever placed.
